scope: Snowdon disposable electrical wire/conduit sizing and schedule notation trial
authority: Direct user answers in this conversation
circuit_raceway_grouping: one circuit per raceway, flag departures
neutral: full size where required; do not assume neutral not current carrying
equipment_ground: insulated copper EGC; distinguish EGC from GEC/bonding jumper
route_length: actual routing when available; do not substitute geometric straight-line or Revit calculated circuit length without identifying its basis
termination: 60C default for100Aorless unless verified higher-rated equipment; above100A75C subject to actual equipment; 90C insulation is adjustment base not automatic terminal ampacity
breaker_authority: retain existing OCPD; do not infer or revise engineering ratings from a reference table
special_circuits: motor/HVAC/PV/transformer/service/firepump/elevator need applicable equipment and code-rule inputs; process separately
notation: phase and required neutral plus insulated EGC, size/count, raceway type/trade size and parallel sets; do not mislabel schedule note as altered native Wire Size
